title: MatrixResponse
description:
The travel-time matrix the dispatch screen loads to run VROOM. It is not an API response: it
is a static asset of the web Worker, the same JSON as the committed fixture
`crates/seed/data/<city>/matrix.json` (ADR 0012, decision 7), and this type only fixes its
shape.

built.description: When the build ran, or `seed:<n>` for the synthetic city.

city.description: The city the build is for, or `synthetic`.

depot.description: The bakery's place, where every route starts and ends; 0 when left out.

minutes.description:
`minutes[i][j]`: whole minutes driving from place `i` to place `j`, 0 on the diagonal.
Not necessarily symmetric.

source.description: Where the travel times come from, with the attribution the data's licence asks for.

MatrixPlace.description: One place of the travel-time matrix.

index.description: 0 to the places' count less one, in order.

label.description: The map label, `p1` to `p64`; no name, coordinate or street.
